reviews.comment:
El ACA de Tortugas no falla: excelente atención, baños siempre limpios, un parque increíble y bien cuidado.

Siempre paramos cuando vamos y volvemos de Córdoba; es un lugar ideal para hacer una pausa, recuperarse y seguir el viaje. Muy recomendable.

(Translated by Google)
The ACA in Tortugas never disappoints: excellent service, always clean restrooms, and an amazing, well-maintained park.

We always stop there when traveling to and from Córdoba; it's the perfect place to take a break, recharge, and continue your trip. Highly recommended.

(Translated by Google)
Quiet place. They have excellent sandwiches. They also have frozen meals that you heat up, which are delicious, like lentils. But unfortunately, they don't have much stock, which is hard to understand since frozen meals can be stored for quite a while.

reviews.comment:
El bar atienden muy bien. Ahora sí tenés que cargar diesel hay que ir con paciencia xq el surtidor está separado de los de nafta ya que es una estación de servicio vieja. Entonces tienen a una persona que va y viene entre los dos surtidores pero le da más prioridad al de nafta.

(Translated by Google)
The service at the bar is very good. However, if you need to fill up with diesel, you have to be patient because the pump is separate from the gasoline pumps, as it's an older service station. They have an attendant who goes back and forth between the two pumps, but they prioritize the gasoline pump.
